expectations.text: Treats the cash-buyer claim as unverified, in any wording, everywhere it appears
expectations.evidence: 'Dale says he reps a cash buyer; nothing shows a buyer, a mandate, or money'; script repeats 'cash buyer' only as what the caller said, followed by 'I haven't verified the buyer or the money yet'. Internal inconsistency noted: it says proof of funds decides 'whether "cash" can be repeated' yet repeats it in the script; still treated as unverified throughout.

expectations.text: Treats Dale as an intermediary, distinct from the buyer and from the source of funds
expectations.evidence: 'Dale's role: principal's broker under a written mandate, or an intermediary passing along a requirement -> whether one call reaches the person with the money'; 'A letter from Dale is Dale's statement, not proof.'

expectations.text: Delivers a usable opening for the owner call without waiting for a property
expectations.evidence: 'The owner call below can go ahead today as written' plus opening, objection answer and two questions.

expectations.text: Names proof of funds and the buyer's identity (or Dale's authority to represent the buyer) as evidence to get
expectations.evidence: 'Who the buyer is (entity and principal)'; 'Proof of funds: whose account, how much, dated when'; 'what he can put in writing about his role'; script: 'I'm asking for both'.
No market or pricing inputs; 'Calculations run: none'. Not yet: 'Any price or value for their building'.
'nothing shows a buyer, a mandate, or money'; 'A letter from Dale is Dale's statement, not proof.'

Opening: 'a broker rang me this morning saying he has a cash buyer looking for industrial in South Florida in the $10 to $20 million range. I haven't verified the buyer or the money yet, so I'm not calling with an offer.' Borderline, not triggered: 'a broker' is unestablished (the response lists 'Whether Dale is licensed' as something to verify), and 'cash buyer' is repeated but as Dale's statement with an immediate disclaimer.
No contract, date or provision is discussed; nothing stated about which provision controls or any party's rights.

format_checks.evidence: 'Finding: You have one unverified phone call... That earns an exploratory call to the owner, where you say what you heard as you heard it.'
'Next action: Call Dale back and ask who the buyer is and what he can put in writing about his role - you.'
'VERIFIED as said to you; content REPORTED'; 'UNKNOWN'. Same slip as noted: 'A broker called you' under 'Can say out loud' while licensure is to be verified.
Ends with 'Work record: Evidence checked: none beyond your message | Calculations run: none | ...'
Range stated twice (can-say line and script).
